classification.difficultyReason: Identify the fifth month as the interval from month 4 to month 5, evaluate the population at the endpoints, and divide the change by the elapsed time.

content.prompt: The population of trout in a trout farm is growing. Let the population after $t$ months be $P=10\times 1.4^t$.

children.label: a
children.prompt: Find the number of trout in the farm initially.

children.label: b
children.prompt: Find the average rate of growth of the population during the first $5$ months. Give your answer to the nearest whole trout per month.

answer.worked:
The first five months run from $t=0$ to $t=5$. Divide the change in population by the elapsed time.

$$\begin{align*}\text{Average rate}&=\frac{P(5)-P(0)}{5-0}\\\text{Average rate}&=\frac{10\times 1.4^5-10}{5}\\\text{Average rate}&=8.75648\text{ trout/month}\\\text{Average rate}&\approx9\text{ trout/month}.\end{align*}$$

children.label: c
children.prompt: Find the average rate of growth of the population during the fifth month. Give your answer to the nearest whole trout per month.

answer.worked:
The fifth month runs from $t=4$ to $t=5$.

$$\begin{align*}\text{Average rate}&=\frac{P(5)-P(4)}{5-4}\\\text{Average rate}&=\frac{10\times 1.4^5-10\times 1.4^4}{1}\\\text{Average rate}&=15.3664\text{ trout/month}\\\text{Average rate}&\approx15\text{ trout/month}.\end{align*}$$
